body.statement: Uniformly for \(p\in\mathcal P\), the certified offset satisfies \(J_N(p,\gamma_\epsilon)-\inf_{|\gamma|\le G}J_N(p,\gamma)\le\epsilon+o(1)\).
body.justification: A diffusion optimizer is operationally meaningful only if its certificate transfers to the actual integer-capacity experiment.
body.gap: Borst, Mandelbaum, and Reiman prove recovery for an open-queue cost, not the finite-source inferential objective here.
body.consumer: The staffing manager can implement \(M_N=\lceil Na+\gamma_\epsilon\sqrt N\rceil\) with asymptotically certified finite-system regret.
body.proof_tex:
By the uniform energy convergence in the diffusion theorem and the common
positive lower bound on \(V_{0,N}+V_{1,N}\) and \(V_0+V_\gamma\), the
inequality
\[
 |\sqrt x-\sqrt y|\leq\frac{|x-y|}{\sqrt x+\sqrt y}
\]
implies
\[
 \Delta_N:=\sup_{p\in\mathcal P,\,|\gamma|\leq G}
 |J_N(p,\gamma)-J(p,\gamma)|\longrightarrow0.                    \tag{56}
\]
The capacity certificate gives
\(J(p,\gamma_\epsilon)-\inf_{|\gamma|\leq G}J(p,\gamma)\leq\epsilon\).
Adding and subtracting \(J\) and applying (56) yields, uniformly in \(p\),
\[
\begin{split}
 J_N(p,\gamma_\epsilon)-\inf_{|\gamma|\leq G}J_N(p,\gamma)
 &\leq J(p,\gamma_\epsilon)-\inf_{|\gamma|\leq G}J(p,\gamma)
      +2\Delta_N\\
 &\leq\epsilon+o(1),
\end{split}
\]
which is the claimed finite-system regret certificate.
